qualifier: de novo synthesis via tryptophan-kynurenine pathway
name: NAD(P)+ metabolism and tryptophan-kynurenine de novo synthesis
rationale: Members cover NAD+/NADP+ synthesis, salvage, catabolism and transport plus tryptophan-kynurenine-quinolinate catabolism feeding de novo NAD+, distinguishing it from coenzyme A/pyruvate and polyamine neighbours.

qualifier: by DNA methylation and genomic imprinting
name: DNA methylation-based gene silencing and genomic imprinting
rationale: All members concern DNA/CpG methylation-driven silencing, facultative heterochromatin and imprinting, whereas confusables centre on histone lysine/arginine methylation and remodelling complexes.

qualifier: isoform-specific ligand binding, splicing and activating point mutants
name: FGFR1-3 isoform ligand binding and activating mutants
rationale: Members are FGFR1/2/3 b/c isoform ligand binding, FGFR2 splicing and activating point mutants, while confusables add downstream FRS/SHC/PLC/PI3K cascades and FGFR4.

qualifier: definitive endoderm, lateral plate mesoderm and gut tube
name: Definitive endoderm, lateral plate mesoderm and embryonic gut morphogenesis
rationale: Members specify definitive endoderm and lateral plate mesoderm and shape fore/hindgut, distinguishing them from gastrulation, primitive streak and mesendoderm neighbours.

qualifier: negative regulation
name: Negative regulation of cell proliferation in kidney development
rationale: Members restrain proliferation and stem cell maintenance during kidney/metanephros development, unlike confusables on kidney size, mesenchymal apoptosis and nephron differentiation.

qualifier: asymmetric neuroblast division and midbrain dopaminergic differentiation
name: Neural progenitor asymmetric division and midbrain dopaminergic neurogenesis
rationale: Members cover neuroblast/radial glia proliferation, asymmetric division and stem cell maintenance with midbrain dopaminergic differentiation, which confusables on cortical migration, cerebellum or sympathetic neurons lack.

qualifier: cellular uptake and intracellular processing defects
name: Cobalamin cellular uptake and intracellular processing defects
rationale: Members are cobalamin metabolism and CD320/MMACHC/MMADHC defects, separating them from dietary uptake/transport (CBLIF, TCN2) and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase defects.

core: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of receptor mutants
qualifier: KIT
name: KIT mutant binding and resistance to tyrosine kinase inhibitors
rationale: Every member is KIT mutant TKI binding or drug resistance, distinguishing it from FLT3 and PDGFR TKI themes and from KIT mutant signalling.

qualifier: BDNF/NT-3/NT-4 via TRKB and TRKC
name: BDNF and NT-3/4 signalling through TRKB and TRKC
rationale: Members are BDNF/NTF3/NTF4 activation of NTRK2/NTRK3 and their RAS, PI3K, PLCG1 and FRS outputs, whereas confusables cover NGF-TRKA signalling.

qualifier: heavy metal detoxification via MTF1 and metallothioneins
name: Heavy metal ion response and metallothionein detoxification
rationale: Members respond to cadmium, lead, mercury, cobalt, copper, zinc and other metals with MTF1/metallothionein detoxification, unlike ROS detoxification or zinc/copper transporter neighbours.

qualifier: membrane tubulation and vesicle budding
name: Membrane tubulation and vesicle budding in intracellular transport
rationale: Members concern vesicle budding, endosomal membrane tubulation, membrane docking and cargo traffic, distinguishing them from Golgi/COPI, Rab GTPase and ER translocation neighbours.

qualifier: stress control via eIF2 and GCN2
name: Translation initiation and its stress-responsive eIF2 control
rationale: Members cover 43S/48S formation, scanning, 60S joining, eIF2 recycling and GCN2/ER-stress translational control, which termination/NMD and rRNA transcription neighbours lack.

qualifier: host cell attachment, receptor-mediated entry and fusion
name: Viral attachment and receptor-mediated entry into host cells
rationale: Members are mostly attachment, endocytic entry and fusion of dengue, influenza, RSV and HIV, distinguishing them from coronavirus protein maturation and host antiviral suppression neighbours.

qualifier: regulation of intrinsic apoptosis and p21 G1 arrest
name: p53 control of DNA damage-induced apoptosis and G1 arrest
rationale: Members regulate p53 expression/activity, p21-driven G1 arrest and positive/negative control of p53-mediated intrinsic apoptosis, unlike neighbours on p53 death-gene transcription or radiation checkpoints.

qualifier: brush border microvilli and glomerular podocytes
name: Epithelial polarity, brush border and podocyte development
rationale: Members cover apical-basal polarity, microvillus/brush border assembly and podocyte/glomerular basement membrane development, distinct from glomerular endothelial/mesangial and adherens-junction neighbours.

qualifier: HNF4/CDX-driven enterocyte and crypt renewal programme
name: HNF4/CDX-driven intestinal epithelium differentiation and renewal
rationale: Members are HNF4/CDX intestinal absorptive and crypt epithelial modules and intestinal epithelial development, distinct from melanocyte, keratinocyte and antimicrobial defensin neighbours.

qualifier: ATRX/DAXX packaging suppressing telomere recombination
name: Telomeric heterochromatin packaging restraining telomere recombination
rationale: Members concern telomere end packaging, subtelomeric heterochromatin and ATRX/DAXX inhibition of telomeric recombination, unlike neighbours on ALT recombination, C-strand synthesis or telomerase extension.

qualifier: photoreceptor and retinal neuron development with phototransduction
name: Retinal neuron development and photoreceptor phototransduction
rationale: Members cover rod/cone, bipolar and amacrine development, outer segment organization and phototransduction, distinct from retinoid cycle/opsin and eye morphogenesis neighbours.

qualifier: LXR (NR1H2/NR1H3) regulated
name: LXR-regulated triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis
rationale: Members are LXR-driven lipogenesis/lipolysis/gluconeogenesis gene control and triglyceride homeostasis, unlike PPARA/SREBP, adipogenesis and glucagon-PKA neighbours.

qualifier: CENP-A centromeric nucleosome deposition
name: Chromosome condensation and CENP-A centromeric chromatin assembly
rationale: Members cover mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation, nucleosome assembly and CENP-A deposition, distinguishing them from sister chromatid cohesion and histone acetylation neighbours.

qualifier: type 1 and type 2 promoters
name: RNA polymerase III initiation at type 1 and 2 promoters
rationale: All members are Pol III initiation at type 1/2 (tRNA) promoters, while confusables add type 3/snRNA, elongation, termination and Pol I rRNA.

qualifier: cornification and skin barrier
name: Keratinocyte differentiation, cornification and epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation, cornified envelope and skin barrier, distinct from melanocyte, hair follicle and wound-healing neighbours.

qualifier: nuclear-cytosolic, with snoRNP Cajal body localization
name: Nuclear-cytosolic RNA modification and Cajal body snoRNA localization
rationale: Members are rRNA/tRNA/mRNA/snRNA methylation and pseudouridylation with snoRNP assembly and Cajal body targeting, unlike rRNA cleavage/decay and mitochondrial RNA modification neighbours.

qualifier: chemotaxis, MCP-1 regulation and activation
name: Monocyte chemotaxis and activation in inflammatory response
rationale: Members regulate monocyte chemotaxis, MCP-1 production, extravasation, activation and aggregation within inflammation, distinct from endothelial adhesion, monocyte surface signature and CCR2/CX3CR1 module neighbours.

qualifier: CCR2/CX3CR1 chemotaxis and endogenous danger-ligand sensing
name: Monocyte-macrophage recruitment and endogenous danger-signal sensing
rationale: Members cover monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, CCR2/CX3CR1 modules and AGE, class B scavenger and endogenous TLR ligand sensing, which adhesion, surface-signature and generic chemokine neighbours lack.
